outputs.reasoning: I identified the company at figma.com as Figma, Inc. and used public evidence to determine both its latest evidenced private venture round and its current lifecycle status as of 2026-09-30. The strongest lifecycle evidence is Figma’s SEC final prospectus for its initial public offering, which confirms NYSE listing approval under ticker FIG and the $33 IPO price. A NYSE quote-page search result supports that trading data begins on 2025-07-31, so I treated Figma as public by that date. For funding, Figma’s own 2021 Series E blog post confirms the round name and lead investor, while Bloomberg’s contemporaneous report provides the $200 million amount. No later venture equity round was evidenced before the IPO in the sources reviewed.
